2 . This first bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the applicant Babloo S/o Rampukarsada for grant of regular bail, who has been arrested on 04/11/2023 in connection with Crime No.468/2023,
date (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Kalyanpura, District Jhabua (M.P.) for commission of offences under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(N) and 506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 5(L)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.

sentences.text: The alleged incident took place on 20/08/2023 and FIR was lodged belatedly on 02/10/2023 and prosecutrix was recovered on 03/11/2023 along with applicant.
Applicant is a young person of 19 years of age.
He is in jail since 04/11/2023, meaning thereby, he has suffered jail incarceration for near about 01 year and 05 months.
Conclusion of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12349 2 MCRC-20005-2025 trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Learned Deputy Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent / State has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: 5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. After considering all the aspects and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, rival submissions of the counsel for the parties and also looking to the period of custody, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3)
of BNSS.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the precondition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
